faces._role: AOM piezo transducer RF input (SMA). Position = transducerOffsetFromCenterMmX ? rfPropagationDirectionBodyLocal. RF sink: read by diffract_aom op from 禮7.5 tracer's signalAtPort, not a ray-tracer entry face ??no transition listed.
faces._USER_TODO: x=15mm is the migration 0083 default ??refine to the actual SMA jack offset on the MT80-A1.5 housing.

notes.geometry: Body +z = optical axis from physical face A to physical face B. RF travels along +x via rfPropagationDirectionBodyLocal (perpendicular to optical axis). Aperture 1.5 mm (A1.5 = 1.5 mm clear aperture, vs A1 = 1.0 mm).
notes.variant: MT80-A1.5-IR: 80 MHz center freq, 1.5 mm aperture, IR coating (780-1100 nm). RF bandwidth ~30 MHz around center (vs MT110-A1 with 110 MHz center / 50 MHz BW).
notes.bragg: Bragg angle theta_B = lambda * f_rf / (2 * n * v_a). At 780nm, 80MHz: theta_B = 780e-9 * 80e6 / (2 * 2.26 * 4200) ~ 3.29 mrad ~ 0.19 deg.
notes.braggAcceptance: braggAngularAcceptanceMrad = external half-width to the first sinc^2 detuning null = n * v_a / (f_rf * L) = 2.26 * 4200 / (80e6 * 1.6e-3) ~ 74.2 mrad. Drives the off-axis diffraction-efficiency rolloff sinc^2(dk*L/2). Derived from physics (was a placeholder 2.0 mrad on the frontend).
notes.dynamicFreq: SceneObject.dynamicSources.aomFreqMhz overrides centerFreqMhz at trace time.
notes.dynamicRfPower: SceneObject.dynamicSources.rfDrivePowerW / aomRfVpp resolved from post-amplifier RF chain.
